'''Kellen''' was the [[human]] owner of a [[Mina-Rau General Store|general store]]<ref name="Kellen" /> on the agricultural [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]].<ref name="OYL" /> A friendly individual, Kellen was a reliable source of news and rumors for other individuals on Mina-Rau.<ref name="Kellen" />
